title: Playing with Kid Clayton and Joe Robichaux
summary: Harris worked with Robichaux's good band and placed his cousin in it when Joe went on the road.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, yeah, you might get it. He and I was playing with Kid Clinton at the same time too. Then with Joe Robichaud, I worked a while with Joe Robichaud then he was in the band.
Was that the big band, or not the real big band, but maybe ten pieces or so that made records once with Joe, do you remember?
I think that's the old rugby show band. No.
No, that was Joe. Joe had one of the best bands he ever played. Oh yeah, he had a good band at that time.
Yes, yes, yes, yes. This boy at Van Dykes was playing, was playing tenor leading Buddy Johnson band.

He was a tenor player. He was playing the game. When Joe got ready to go on the road, I played with him at the Jack's room and he asked me if I was playing. So that's when I put my little cousin Maurice Jessen with him. Maurice is still in that thing. No, he just don't play no more. Every day I see him, he's going to try to get him a clarinet, he might start playing again. He can play.
